project.name: build-parent
project.description: The build parent: global configuration (properties, dependency/plugin management, common test dependencies, repositories, profiles) inherited by every module. Carries NO <modules> — aggregation is the aggregators' job (root pom.xml and the per-space poms). OSGi-specific build config (bnd) lives in osgi/bundle-parent, not here.

requireReleaseVersion.message: Reactor SNAPSHOTs must not be installed to ~/.m2 — siblings resolve through the reactor via -am. Only a deliberate RELEASE-versioned baseline jar may be installed.

bannedDependencies.message: org.osgi:osgi.cmpn (the OSGi compendium aggregate) must not reach the dependency graph — it splits the staged DS-API packages. It is excluded from pax-logging in the BOM; if it reappeared, a new transitive path introduced it. Add the matching <exclusion> in bom/pom.xml.
